features.title: Recording you can see
features.description: While Point and talk records, the message box shows a red dot, Recording and the time. A red line runs around the recorded screen, over every app but not in the video.
features.where: The left end of the message box's bottom row, and the edges of the recorded screen

features.title: Point and talk
features.description: Record the screen under your pointer and your voice, no picking an app. Your words come out as text, the spots you point at become pictures, and it all goes to the agent in one message.
features.where: The camera button next to Send, or Shift+Ctrl+S anywhere

features.title: Side chat under Now
features.description: Side chat now sits under the right panel's tab instead of over it. Drag the line between them, double-click it to reset, or click the header to fold it.

features.title: Square corners
features.description: Buttons, cards, the input box and your message bubbles now use the same small corners as VS Code.

features.title: Clearer thinking level
features.description: The thinking level menu only lists the levels. A level you picked before is marked Last picked next to the Default one.
features.where: The level next to the model name under the message box
